description.value: Blue River #213 is a branch of the Royal Canadian Legion, a national veterans' organization dedicated to supporting veterans, promoting remembrance, and serving the local community. In small rural communities like Blue River along Highway 5, Legion branches often operate licensed premises that may be open to the public. Whether this branch serves food or drink to passing travellers is not confirmed from available sources.
